20.1 Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer, its Affiliates, and their directors, officers, employees, and agents from each third-party claim and resulting damages, settlements, judgments, penalties, costs, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising from an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate an intellectual property right.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">Section 20 meets the preferred position in full. Vendor defends, indemnifies and holds harmless Customer and its Affiliates against third-party IP infringement/misappropriation claims regarding the Services or Deliverables (20.1) and against claims arising from Vendor's breach of Applicable Law, unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor, and Vendor's gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud (20.2). Procedure is workable: prompt notice, reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense, control of the defence, plus settlement-consent protection (20.4). Customer's indemnity is narrow, limited to unmodified Customer-supplied material used strictly as authorized and Customer's violation of Applicable Law (20.3). Beyond preferred, 20.5 adds procure/modify/replace and refund remedies and 21.3 makes indemnification obligations Excluded Claims, so the indemnity is not squeezed by the cap; the fallback 3x super-cap would be worse for us and is not sought. No redline required.
